pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Sehr gut" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. please
   B. very good
   C. yes
   D. see you soon

2. What does "der Mittwoch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. week
   B. Saturday
   C. Monday
   D. Wednesday

3. What does "der Sonntag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. week
   C. Sunday
   D. Saturday

4. What does "der Finger" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. foot
   B. toe
   C. tummy
   D. finger

5. What does "Auf Wiedersehen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. see you soon
   C. yes
   D. good morning

6. How is the letter V named in German? (1 mark)
   A. fow
   B. ah
   C. hah
   D. ess

7. What does "Wir wohnen in einem Haus" mean? (1 mark)
   A. We sell a house
   B. We live in a house
   C. We play in a garden
   D. We cook in a house

8. Which little word goes with the noun "Kühlschrank"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. der
   D. das

9. Which German word means "always"? (time) (1 mark)
   A. oft
   B. heute
   C. immer
   D. gestern

10. What does "der Donnerstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Monday
   C. Thursday
   D. weekend

11. What does "November" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. December
   B. September
   C. March
   D. November

12. Which little word goes with the noun "Geschenk"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. die
   D. das

13. What does "die Kartoffel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. meat
   B. bread
   C. potato
   D. tomato

14. What does "denn" mean in "Ich mag keine Cola, denn Cola ist nicht gesund"? (1 mark)
   A. because
   B. but
   C. then
   D. and

15. Which food group does "der Kohl" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Fleisch
   B. die Getränke
   C. das Obst
   D. das Gemüse

16. What is the plural of "das Bein"? (1 mark)
   A. die Beinen
   B. die Beins
   C. die Beine
   D. die Beiner

17. What is the plural of "die Schwester"? (1 mark)
   A. die Schwestern
   B. die Schwestere
   C. die Schwester
   D. die Schwesters

18. Which German word means "to cook"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. kochen
   B. spielen
   C. riechen
   D. sehen

19. Which of these is NOT a noun? (1 mark)
   A. spiele
   B. Montag
   C. Schule
   D. Fußball

20. Which German word means "to drink"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. schlafen
   B. lesen
   C. trinken
   D. hören

21. What is the plural of "das Geschenk"? (1 mark)
   A. die Geschenks
   B. die Geschenker
   C. die Geschenken
   D. die Geschenke

22. What does "der zweite" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. second
   B. third
   C. seventh
   D. first

23. Which German word means "January"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. Januar
   B. März
   C. November
   D. Juli

24. Which German word or phrase means "bean"? (1 mark)
   A. die Zwiebel
   B. die Bohne
   C. die Wassermelone
   D. die Mango

25. Which food group does "die Milch" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. das Fleisch
   C. das Obst
   D. die Getränke

26. Which German word or phrase means "egg"? (1 mark)
   A. die Banane
   B. das Mittagessen
   C. das Ei
   D. der Kakao

27. What is the plural of "der Fuß"? (1 mark)
   A. die Füß
   B. die Füße
   C. die Fuße
   D. die Fußen

28. Which German word or phrase means "arm"? (1 mark)
   A. die Nase
   B. der Arm
   C. der Kopf
   D. das Knie

29. Which German word means "cold"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. kalt
   B. heiß
   C. wolkig
   D. neblig

30. What does "heiß" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. windy
   B. hot
   C. dry
   D. cold

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the German words with der, die or das for: arm, sister. (2 marks)

32. Write the German words with der, die or das for: watermelon, pot. (2 marks)

33. Explain why "Meine Mutter sind nett" is wrong and correct it. (2 marks)

34. Write the German words with der, die or das for: shower, bean. (2 marks)

35. Write the German words with der, die or das for: plate, lamp, tomato, knee. (4 marks)

36. Write the German for: I cook, I sleep, I read, I play. (4 marks)

37. Write a sentence in German that tells in which month your birthday is. (2 marks)

38. Unscramble the words: SICHT and TETB. Write them with their articles. (2 marks)

39. Read and translate: "Wo ist der Ball? Er ist im Garten." (2 marks)

40. Write the German names of these months: January, February, March. (3 marks)

41. Write the German words with their articles for: sun, cloud, rain, snow. (4 marks)

42. Read: "Kamau hat Geburtstag. Er ist zehn Jahre alt." Say in English who has a birthday and how old he is. (2 marks)

43. Write three steps you follow to understand a German text. (3 marks)

44. Write in German: "The lamp is next to the bed." (2 marks)

45. Write in German what you do on Saturday. Start with "Am Samstag". (2 marks)

46. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bed, birthday, banana. (3 marks)

47. Say why we practise tongue twisters when learning to pronounce German. (2 marks)

48. Write the numbers 3, 9 and 12 in German. (3 marks)

49. Read aloud and write the sound of these words: Schule, heute, Haus, Tür. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — very good
   Sehr gut means very good.

2. D — Wednesday
   der Mittwoch means Wednesday.

3. C — Sunday
   der Sonntag means Sunday.

4. D — finger
   der Finger means finger.

5. A — goodbye
   Auf Wiedersehen means goodbye.

6. A — fow
   In German the letter V is called fow.

7. B — We live in a house
   wohnen means to live and wir means we.

8. C — der
   It is der Kühlschrank, so the little word is der.

9. C — immer
   always in German is immer.

10. C — Thursday
   der Donnerstag means Thursday.

11. D — November
   November means November.

12. D — das
   It is das Geschenk, so the little word is das.

13. C — potato
   die Kartoffel means potato.

14. A — because
   denn gives a reason.

15. D — das Gemüse
   der Kohl belongs to das Gemüse.

16. C — die Beine
   The plural of das Bein is die Beine.

17. A — die Schwestern
   The plural of die Schwester is die Schwestern.

18. A — kochen
   to cook in German is kochen.

19. A — spiele
   spiele is a verb. Nouns begin with capital letters.

20. C — trinken
   to drink in German is trinken.

21. D — die Geschenke
   The plural of das Geschenk is die Geschenke.

22. A — second
   der zweite means second.

23. A — Januar
   January in German is Januar.

24. B — die Bohne
   bean in German is die Bohne.

25. D — die Getränke
   die Milch belongs to die Getränke.

26. C — das Ei
   egg in German is das Ei.

27. B — die Füße
   The plural of der Fuß is die Füße.

28. B — der Arm
   arm in German is der Arm.

29. A — kalt
   cold in German is kalt.

30. B — hot
   heiß means hot.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Arm, die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Wassermelone, der Topf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: With one person we use ist. Correct: Meine Mutter ist nett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason and 1 mark for the correction.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Dusche, die Bohne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Teller, die Lampe, die Tomate, das Knie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ich koche, ich schlafe, ich lese, ich spiele.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich habe im Mai Geburtstag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for a correctly spelled month.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Tisch, das Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with article.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: Where is the ball? It is in the garden.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Januar, Februar, März.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Sonne, die Wolke, der Regen, der Schnee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kamau has a birthday and he is ten years old.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fact.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the title and pictures; read once for the gist; read again for details and answers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Die Lampe ist neben dem Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the sentence pattern and 1 mark for neben dem Bett.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Am Samstag, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Bett, der Geburtstag, die Banane.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: They repeat similar sounds, so the tongue and lips learn to move clearly and smoothly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for repeated sounds and 1 mark for clear speech.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: drei, neun, zwölf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

49. (4 marks)
   Answer: Schule = SHOO-le, heute = HOY-te, Haus = house (ow), Tür = tür (ee with round lips).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word.
